verdict.rationale: Gunderson's Early-stage company page has a dedicated Formation section. It says the firm has 'helped thousands of founders… launch their businesses from the very start', advising on entity structure, ownership, and making sure the company owns its IP, which places incorporation at the core of its emerging-companies practice. The firm's scale with startup clients (4,500+ company clients) supports this. However, the specific formation deliverables named in the story are only implied, not listed. Missing for 10: explicit mention of drafting the charter/certificate of incorporation, bylaws, initial board consents, and founder stock purchase agreements; independent or hands-on corroboration of the formation workflow.
